Both units are active, but I can't see a fresh dispatch in either log yet. Checking now:㊣ ("lemma work should lead to closures") Agreed, and that's how the ranking should treat lemmas. I've changed it (`9b9a2d8d`) so the lemma DAG is read in terms of the problems it's meant to close.

㊢ (what changed)
- **`priorities` leads with problems.** It now starts with one line per open problem: placeholders, banked lemmas, and backlog lemmas still needed. A problem with no backlog left gets marked `COMPLETE-elect-closure-adapter-now`.
- **Strategy prompt:** a problem whose route is complete gets its closure adapter elected before any lemma. Between closures, the checkpoint steers toward the problem with the fewest backlog lemmas left. Before this, the ranking had no notion of finishing a problem; it only counted how many problems a lemma touched.

㊬ (where each problem stands now)

| Problem | Placeholders | Banked lemmas | Backlog lemmas |
|---|---|---|---|
| t93J03 | 1 | 16 | 2 |
| t99J01 | 1 | 6 | 2 |
| t97A03 | 3 | 6 | 3 |
| t97A01 | 1 | 0 | 2 |
| t02A03 | 1 | 6 | 12 |

t93J03 is closest, and topo1 is already on its last Klein steps (boundary-orbit EqvGen). If those two lemmas bank, the next checkpoint should elect t93J03's closure.

㊢ (loops) Both loops restarted at 16:41. topo2 reclaimed its in-flight job without a problem, and topo1 is reclaiming its own.
